name: Third Seat
summary:
Third Seat is an AI-powered VR experience for couples and solo participants who want to practice communication, emotional awareness, and reflection through guided roleplay.

Enter a calming virtual space and speak with Mira, an AI guide who facilitates thoughtful conversation. Mira listens to your real-time voice, reflects on what’s shared, and offers summaries and prompts to deepen understanding. Sessions can be experienced with a partner or individually as a space for reflection and communication practice
